Component family codes (66300-A: Piston shafts, 66301-B: Scanalati shafts, 66311: Hollow shafts, 66410-A: Ring gears, 66420: Planetary gears, 66430: Sun gears, 66555: Plane carriers, 66600: Ring nuts) indicate distinct design standards

summary: This page serves as the master index for the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook (MTQ-001), dated 26.10.2010. It lists all TAB (technical specification) sheets covering manufacturing standards for grinding, threading, bearing seats, seal seats, grooves, splines, keyways, gears, and surface finish requirements. The lower section provides a component family index mapping family codes to specific mechanical components including various shaft types, gear types (planetary, sun, ring), planet carriers, and housings.
